name: Kano
blurb: Ancient city, dye pits older than your great-grandfather, and the best kilishi you will ever eat.

events.text: Your PPA is a secondary school in Kano. The students call you 'Corper Teacher' and correct your Hausa with great patience. By month six you can haggle at Kurmi market.
A Kano trader you befriended offers you a small consignment of leather bags to resell in Abuja. Good margin, if you can move them.

name: Enugu
blurb: Coal City. Rolling hills, abacha on every corner, and uncles who ask what you are doing with your life.

events.text: Your PPA boss in Enugu runs a printing press and teaches you how to price jobs properly. 'Never do business with family on credit,' he says, then sells to his cousin on credit.
A landlord in Enugu demands rent in advance even for corpers. You negotiate down with a CDS certificate and pure audacity.

name: Lagos
blurb: Somehow, against all odds, you got Lagos. Traffic is a lifestyle. Everyone has three jobs.

events.text: In Lagos you share a mini-flat with four corpers in Yaba. The tech scene is wild. You sneak into a startup meetup and leave with two job leads.
Third Mainland Bridge traffic eats four hours a day. You start making skits about it. One goes viral.

name: Rivers
blurb: Port Harcourt: Garden City, oil money, generator noise and the best bole and fish.

events.text: Your PPA is an oil-servicing company. You watch people make in a week what your parents made in a year. You take notes.
Soot from illegal refineries settles on your white shirts. A local NGO recruits you for a clean-air campaign.

name: Benue
blurb: Food Basket of the Nation. Yam, rice, and hospitality that embarrasses Abuja.

events.text: You teach agricultural science in a Benue secondary school. A farmer explains more about supply chains in an afternoon than your lecturer did in a semester.
Your CDS group builds a small borehole for a village. The chief gives you a goat. You do not know what to do with a goat.

name: Cross River
blurb: Calabar: clean streets, carnival season, edikang ikong that changes lives.

events.text: Calabar carnival season. You volunteer and end up dancing in a costume with feathers. Your Instaflex grows by 2,000 followers.
Your PPA is a hotel. You learn hospitality, and you learn that tourists tip in dollars.

name: Ogun
blurb: Next to Lagos, cheaper than Lagos, full of factories and Lagos workers who sleep there.

events.text: Your PPA is a factory in Ota. You learn production planning and how to survive on 'staff canteen' rice.
You start selling Adire fabric to your Abuja friends online. Small orders, steady orders.

name: Kogi
blurb: Where the Niger meets the Benue. Lokoja's confluence view is free; the roads are not smooth.

events.text: The Abuja–Lokoja road is an adventure novel. You spend one Friday night in traffic behind a fallen trailer and make three friends.
Your PPA is a local government office. Your job title is 'Assistant'. Of what, nobody knows.
